in_sanskrit.name: चिन्मय
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: चित् (Chit) - Consciousness, मनस् (Manas) - Mind, व्याप्ति (Vyapti) - All pervading

in_hindi.name: चिन्मय
in_hindi.meaning: ज्ञान (Gyan) - Knowledge, सुक्षम (Suksam) - Subtle, विज्ञान (Vijnan) - Wisdom

in_telugu.name: చిన్మయ
in_telugu.meaning: జ్ఞానం (Jnana) - Knowledge, సుదృశ్చేదియ (Sudhrusha) - Subtle, పృథివీ (Prithvi) - Earth

in_marathi.name: Chinmay
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness of the Absolute
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chinmaya', meaning 'consciousness of the Absolute'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu philosophy, representing the pursuit of inner wisdom and the realization of one's true self.

in_bengali.name: Chinmay

in_bengali.long_meaning: Chinmay একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chinmaya', meaning 'consciousness of the Absolute'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu philosophy, representing the pursuit of inner wisdom and the realization of one's true self.

vedic_reference.note: The Chinmaya Upanishad explains the nature of the Self and the universe, emphasizing the importance of Self-realization and the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. This name is derived from the Upanishad, and is deeply rooted in Vedic tradition.
